subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar as propriedades dos materiais para avaliar a adequação de seu uso em diferentes aplicações (industriais, cotidianas, arquitetônicas ou tecnológicas) e/ ou propor soluções seguras e sustentáveis considerando seu contexto local e cotidiano.

components.description_pt: Analisar propriedades físicas e químicas de materiais relevantes a aplicações específicas
components.description_en: Analyze physical and chemical properties of materials relevant to specific applications
components.cc_component_description: Explain why different applications require materials with different physical or chemical properties

components.description_pt: Examinar propriedades de materiais para determinar sua adequação para uso em estrutura ou sistema específico
components.description_en: Examine the properties of materials to determine their suitability for use in a specific structure or system
components.cc_component_description: Examine the properties of materials to determine their suitability for use in a specific structure or system

components.description_pt: Propor soluções de materiais seguras e sustentáveis apropriadas a contexto local ou cotidiano
components.description_en: Propose safe and sustainable material solutions appropriate to a local or everyday context
components.cc_component_description: Use scientific evidence to propose a solution to a design problem in a given context

cc_matches.description: Investigating or designing new systems or structures requires a detailed examination of the properties of different materials, the structures of different components, and connections of components to reveal its function and/or solve a problem.
Different properties are suited to different purposes.
Apply scientific ideas, principles, and/or evidence to provide an explanation of phenomena and solve design problems, taking into account possible unanticipated effects.
